en: You found the last hall! I built the dome for one reason: so that every Pokémon could feel what it is to be cheered.
Battles aren't everything. Friendship is what makes a Pokémon run, jump and push with all it has.
An empty pedestal. Its plaque says a statue will stand here for the Trainer who wins gold on every course.
The dome's motto in big letters: "Every Pokémon can shine."
A picture of the dome being built, with the owner and his Poliwrath carrying a beam.
A picture of the dome's first winners, three small Pokémon holding up a trophy together.
